candidates.title: Send a triggered test email through Make

demandEvidence.chore: Send an email through a named provider when another app trigger occurs.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want a Make scenario to send an email through DigitalAka when a trigger occurs in another app.

ease.reason: A single test trigger and inbox are mockable, but the source gives no provider setup steps.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a workflow consultant may value notification setup; the request proves no service buyer.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can test one event and test recipient; SMTP delivery and errors remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A configured trigger could send a test message; a person must configure access and confirm delivery.

evidence.reason: The request specifies an app trigger followed by provider email, with no frequency or working example.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: the task is clear enough for a mock, but no supplied implementation reference supports provider configuration or delivery.

candidates.title: Debug and finish an existing Make build

demandEvidence.chore: Debug and finish an existing Make automation build.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Since you’re posting under Hire a Pro → Hire Help , I’d make it clear that you want someone to debug and finish an existing Make build , not rebuild everything from scratch.

ease.reason: A test can capture scenario errors; Make documents handlers that intercept errors, not automated diagnosis.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent automation consultants may value triage help; one request proves no AI service demand.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can flag captured failures, but the reference does not support repairing or completing a build.

autonomy.reason: Make handlers can intercept errors; a person must diagnose, edit and verify the actual scenario.

evidence.reason: The post asks for debugging and completion but identifies no fault or repeated diagnostic output.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: the reference supports error interception only; the discussion names no concrete failure and the proposed helper cannot safely finish the build.

candidates.title: Shape a customer story for a product

demandEvidence.chore: Develop a product story intended to engage a customer.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: What’s the best way to engage a customer in a story for a product that was developed to solve a problem?

ease.reason: A beginner could draft an outline from supplied product notes, but no source documents a method.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a product consultant may value a drafting aid; this question establishes no buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week demo could turn fictional notes into a reviewed outline; format and success criteria are unknown.

autonomy.reason: A tool could draft repeatedly from supplied notes; a person must verify claims and shape the story.

evidence.reason: The question asks how to engage customers through a product story but gives no process or constraints.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: only a broad request is evidenced, with no supported repeatable method or defined output.

rejected.title: Experiences hiring an assistant evaluator
rejected.reason: The author asks for firsthand accounts from people who hired an evaluator; this is not a concrete request to perform a defined evaluation chore, so no task or experiment can be scored without inventing one.

rejected.title: Cloudflare R2 signer configuration question
rejected.reason: This is a one-off question about the officially supported signer configuration for an S3-compatible storage service. It is a bug/configuration support question, not a repeated bounded chore suitable for a proposed service.

steps.message: Assessed all five sealed discussion assignments. Three concrete chores received five provisional ratings; two vague or one-off requests were explicitly excluded. No candidate reaches the unrounded 6-point threshold, so this discussion-only batch proposes no posts.
